## Scope note

Corpus v0 is frozen and the open v0 artefact set is fixed. New
corpus sources, schema changes, and larger models are v1
questions (see ROADMAP.md). Requests that fit the current
artefacts (a converter, a harness improvement, a documentation
fix) are the easiest to accept. Anything that would carry real
personal data through the tokenizer needs a privacy discussion
first, because the schema drops it by design today.
